ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:12 high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous clusters are concentrated at the distal tips (apexes) of both the left and right lobes. Multiple high-contrast linear streaks and small focal mottling spots are distributed throughout the mid-section and near the central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical pixel depth approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with irregular pixel-amplitudes (range 3-12 pixels); jagged peaks and valleys are present along the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile observed on the outer leading edges leading toward the tips; the trailing edge follows an overall convex arc subdivided by the serration map.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) are detected at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered individual rosette marks are visible in the upper-right interior quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned and parallel linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) are detected across the central and right lobe regions, breaking the low-intensity background pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear rake marks; significant tissue loss and irregular scarring at the distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast white 'capping' at both lobe apexes against a predominantly black ventral surface.
